You were wise not to be deceived by Kazuda Xiono's lies. Those who betray us…''"
"''Become our enemy.''"
"''You know, I wasn't born into the First Order. For years, I scraped by under the rule of the New Republic. But I knew I was meant for more. I brought you here because I saw the same potential in you, and you've surpassed all my expectations.|Tierny and Tamara Ryvora in the office|audio=HadMyDoubts-RebuildingTheResistance.flac|}} '''Tierny's office''' was an office maintained by the [[First Order Security Bureau]] [[Agent]] [[Tierny]] on the [[First Order]]'s [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]'' by the [[time]] of the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. During the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} [[Hunt for the Colossus|hunt]] for the ''[[Colossus]]'' [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] in [[34 ABY]], the agent stored the [[Tam's comlink|personal comlink]] of First Order [[cadet]] [[Tamara Ryvora]] in the office. When Ryvora later conversed with Tierny in the office, she took note of where Tierny had stored the device. Later, [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] [[Force power|used]] [[the Force]] to make Tierny and [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] hold each other at [[blaster]]-point as they stood in the room. When [[Desertion|defecting]] from the First Order, Ryvora [[Thief|stole]] her [[comlink]] from the office with the help of [[MSE-6 series repair droid]] [[5-L]]. The room and the rest of the ''Thunderer'' were ultimately destroyed in the [[Barabesh system]] during a [[Battle of Barabesh|battle]] against the [[Resistance]]. ==Description== Tierny's office{{SW|url=rebuilding-the-resistance-concept-art-gallery|text="Rebuilding the Resistance" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slides 11 and 12}} was the personal office of the [[First Order Security Bureau]]'s [[Agent]] [[Tierny]] aboard the [[First Order]] [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]''.''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' The room featured paneled [[Color|gray]] walls, a black floor, and a wide [[viewport]]. Tierny's office also included two illuminated, transparent cases on opposite walls holding her{{Resistance|Descent (episode)}} personal [[weapon]] collection, which consisted of five bladed weapons, four [[rifle]]s, and one [[blaster]]. Near the space's viewport, Tierny had a black, semicircle-shaped desk that featured storage compartments and a [[holoprojector]].{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}} ==History== ===Heart to heart=== {{Quote|While—while its whereabouts are still unknown, we are already working on a solution to that problem, Supreme Leader.''"
"''Your list of failures is long, Agent Tierny. I will not suffer the existence of any Resistance cell, no matter how small. If you are not capable of dealing with them, then I will find someone who can.''
"''We understand, Supreme Leader.''"
"''Do you?|Tierny and Kylo Ren, with the former in the office|audio=WeUnderstand-TheEscape.flac|}} By the [[time]] of the [[First Order-Resistance War]], Tierny maintained a personal office aboard the ''Thunderer''. In [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|2|2}} First Order [[cadet]] [[Tamara Ryvora]] turned in{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}} her [[Tam's comlink|personal comlink]] to her superiors so they could use it in their [[Hunt for the Colossus|hunt]] for the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. Though the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} initial [[Skirmish over D'Qar |attempt]] to destroy the [[Starship|vessel]] was unsuccessful, Tierny stored the [[comlink]] in her office. [[File:DoYouUnderstand-TheEscape.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Kylo Ren forced Tierny and Pyre to aim blasters at each other in the office, disappointed in their failure to find the ''Colossus''.]] Not long afterward, the same [[Standard year|year]],{{ResistanceDate|2|17}} Tierny called Ryvora to her office to question the latter's loyalty and commitment to the First Order. The agent expounded on her personal backstory to the cadet, fiddling with Ryvora's comlink after taking it out of the office's desk drawer. As Tierny admitted that she had originally had doubts about Ryvora, the cadet took note of where the agent placed the device upon returning it to the drawer. When the ''Thunderer'' arrived at the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]][[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]] [[planet]] [[Dantooine]] to [[Blockade of Dantooine|confront]] [[Resistance]] operatives, the agent dismissed the cadet from the room. Not long after, Tierny and [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] reported their successful [[Suppression of the Aeos system|decimation]] of the [[Aeos system]] to General [[Armitage Hux]] in the office via [[hologram]]. However, [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] took Hux's place in the projection and berated Tierny and Pyre for their continued failure to find the ''Colossus'', forcing the pair to draw their blasters and point them at each other [[Force power|with]] [[the Force]]. After being released from the Force's grasp, Tierny and Pyre resolved to double their efforts and left the room. ===Comlink stolen=== {{Quote|Thanks, 5-L. You did great.''"
[5-L beeps]
"''I hope it's still here.|Tamara Ryvora and 5-L as they snuck into the office to acquire the former's comlink|audio=YouDidGreat-TheEscape.flac|}} [[File:Ryvora5Loffice-TheEscape.png|thumb|right|300px|Tamara Ryvora and 5-L snuck into the office to steal the former's comlink from its desk.]] Moments after their departure, Ryvora used the reprogrammed [[MSE-6 series repair droid]] [[5-L]] to sneak into the agent's office and take her comlink from the room's desk, intending to [[Desertion|flee]] the First Order. When Tierny returned to her office, she was distracted by 5-L's presence, allowing Ryvora to slip from the room as the agent questioned the droid, who only [[Cruly-3|beeped]] at her before hurrying away. After Ryvora's [[Galek's TIE fighter squadron|training squadron]] [[hyperspace]] jumped to the planet [[Castilon]]—the ''Colossus''{{'s}} original home—Tierny became suspicious of the recruit's intent and went to her office. After discovering the cadet had taken her personal comlink, she surmised Ryvora's plan to rendezvous with her former colleagues and instructed the ''Thunderer'' to travel to Castilon. Not long afterward, the office—along with the rest of the ''Thunderer''—was destroyed in the [[Barabesh system]] during a [[Battle of Barabesh|battle]] against the ''Colossus''. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:TiernysOffice-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|275px|Concept artwork of the office by Colas Gauthier]] The office first appeared in "[[Rebuilding the Resistance]]," the seventeenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[January 19]], [[2020]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} The location was first identified in the episode's corresponding concept art gallery as Tierny's office. For "Rebuilding the Resistance," [[Lucasfilm Animation]] artist [[Colas Gauthier]] completed two pieces of concept artwork for Tierny's office—one of the room aboard the ''Thunderer'' and one for the weapons displayed in the room's wall cases, which were both attributed to [[September 20]], [[2018]]. In the episode's early development, the scene in the office would have commenced the episode to form the teaser before the title but was ultimately replaced.{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-rebuilding-the-resistance-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 7 Fun Facts from "Rebuilding the Resistance" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:TiernysOffice-ConceptArt.jpg|Tierny's office, Colas Gauthier File:TiernysOfficeWeapons-ConceptArt.jpg|Weapons for Tierny's office's display case, Colas Gauthier |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Tierny's office}} *{{Resistance|Rebuilding the Resistance}} {{1st}} *{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/rebuilding-the-resistance-episode-guide|text="Rebuilding the Resistance" Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} {{1stID|Tierny's office}} *{{BucketsList|fL3IGOQd7yc|"Rebuilding the Resistance"}} *{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-rebuilding-the-resistance-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 7 Fun Facts from "Rebuilding the Resistance" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} *{{SWYouTube|7mM6zaES9hk|"The Escape' [''sic''] Preview | Star Wars Resistance}} *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/the-escape-part-1-episode-guide|text="The Escape" Part 1 Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Offices]] [[Category:Thunderer locations]]
